newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Motorola outperform rate repeated.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Motorola outperform rate repeated.

text.p: -- Gruntal & Co analyst Mona Eraiba on Friday reiterated her outperform rating on Motorola Inc, and recommended the purchase of shares with an $80 a share price target.

-- "Motorola delivered significantly better than expected (fourth quarter) operating results," Eraiba wrote in a report. "Operating EPS (earnings per share) was over $0.55, while including all charges, (fourth quarter) net EPS resulted in $0.39."
-- Motorola reported net earnings on Thursday of $0.39 a share, compared with $0.72 a year ago.

-- Eraiba said Motorola took restructuring charges of over $150 million in the fourth quarter, which was "significantly bigger than expected." She said Motorola had indicated during the third quarter that fourth quarter charges would be in "the tens of millions of dollars range."

-- "We believe Motorola is now positioned to regain its earnings momentum during 1997, as the company has renewed its product lines, restructured its operations, and shows signs that its major markets are improving worldwide," Eraiba wrote.
